findings.what: getAuth() reads env before headers() runs, so Next prerenders the staff pages at build time and throws; plain `npm run build` fails without secrets (.env.example is empty)
Nothing triggers the reminder sweep; the ±5 min window needs a ~5-min scheduler, so out of the box reminders never go out
Rate limiter keeps counts in memory (no effect across serverless instances) and trusts the spoofable x-forwarded-for header
Reassignment doesn't check the new doctor's working hours or whether the appointment is already past
Bookings made <24h ahead get a reminder_at in the past and silently never get a reminder
Schedule shows one color per doctor instead of the Schedule-X rows-per-doctor resource view the PRD asks for
Walk-in/phone bookings send no confirmation email, so those patients never get cancel/reschedule links
